integrity: The theorem is analytic; finite sign enumeration in the verifier only replays the proved signed-tetrahedron classification. Literature searches support but do not logically prove bibliographic uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: Equal-prior pure four-state qubit encodings only.
Uses squared Hilbert--Schmidt geometric discord; no resource-monotonicity claim.
The QRAC comparison is uniform-average success for fixed encodings optimized over binary qubit measurements.
title: Exact tetrahedral maximizers of geometric discord for four-state qubit QRAC ensembles
